title: Two Sum in a Sorted Array

description.p: You are given a sorted array nums and a number target. Return the positions of two numbers that add up to target. An answer is guaranteed to exist and it is unique.
Return the smaller index first, then the larger one (the indices cannot be equal). Note that indexing in the array starts from one, not from zero.

description.pre:
Input: nums = [-2,1,6,9,12], target=18
Output: [3,5]
Explanation: 18 = 6 + 12, 6 has index 3 and 12 has index 5

ul: Time: O(n), where n is the number of elements in the array
